Gleuhr Guide — Therapist (draft)
 Oct 27, 2026  ·  @Aman
This is the draft of the Therapist module of the Gleuhr Guide, for your approval before it is
built into the app. It is for every therapist: the person who numbs, treats, records and
completes each session the doctor signed off. The therapist's desk is clinical only, so this
module has nothing commercial in it.
What is in it: 32 How do I…? cards in eight groups, 13 rules, 10 lessons with 30 check
questions, and 5 sign-off tasks.
How it was checked: every button name and step was read from the app as it is today
(27 Oct). Every refusal message is quoted from the server. Nothing comes from
memory or an old manual.
Screenshots: staging renders with one made-up patient; every other name and every
phone number is hidden. Eight are placed. The others are shown as [Screenshot to add
…] lines until they are rendered.
Who signs off a therapist: the clinic's BM.
How to review: comment on any line, or edit it directly. Anything you change becomes
the text staff see.
1 · Responsibilities
What this desk is for. The doctor decides what is done to a patient's skin today. You carry
it out, exactly as signed off, and record what you did. You numb patients in the waiting
area, run the treatment in a room, take the after photos, and complete the session on your
phone.
You own Applying numbing · starting a treatment once it is
signed off · the pre- and post-treatment checklists
· the machine settings photo · the before and after
photos you take · the units / ml / threads you used ·
your session notes · completing the session ·
marking a treatment "Not done today" with a
reason · asking for a break

blocks.title: Page 2
blocks.text:
Your day, from opening to close.
1 . Sign in on your phone. Open My patients. Turn the alarm sound on if the bar at the
bottom asks you to.
2. Through the day: numb when a patient needs it, start each treatment when it is signed
off and you have a free room, record it, complete it. My patients always shows what is
next.
3. When your phone rings, tap the screen to stop it, then do what it says (numbing ready,
session time up, break over).
4. Before you leave: nothing should be left under Save late, nothing still running on
Timers, and every treatment you could not do should be marked Not done today with a
reason.
5. The day lock is the branch manager's job at the end of the day. Your part is to leave
nothing unsaved.
2 · Rules
These are the rules that bind your desk. The app enforces most of them. Know them
anyway, so a refusal never surprises you.
You never decide What treatment is done, or how much (the doctor
signs it off) · who takes which patient (reception or
the doctor assigns it) · who numbs a patient when
someone is picked (the doctor or reception picks) ·
the next appointment (the support doctor sets it) ·
whether a patient is checked in (reception) ·
whether a break is approved (the doctor)
Hands off to you Reception checks the patient in and assigns you on
Assign therapist or the Therapist planner · the
doctor signs off today's treatment
You hand off to The doctor reads your session record, your notes
and any change from the plan · the support doctor
sees the patient before she leaves · the counsellor
closes the visit
The rule Why
A treatment cannot start before the doctor
signs it off.
The doctor decides what happens to the
skin; you carry out an order that was really
given.

blocks.title: Page 3
blocks.text:
The rule Why
A patient must be checked in before
anything is recorded for her.
Check-in is the clinic's front gate. No check-
in means no visit to record against. A patient
who is not checked in never appears on My
patients.
Numbing is applied in the waiting area,
never in a room.
Rooms are for treatments; the screen says
"Numbing happens in the waiting area,
never in a room".
Only signed-off patients can be numbed. Numbing is part of the doctor's plan for
today.
One live sitting per room. The whole clinic sees which rooms are free.
The app refuses a room that is already in
use.
Record what you really did, never what the
plan said.
If the units you used differ from the plan,
both versions are kept and the doctor sees
the difference. The doctor's order is never
overwritten.
Treatments are logged in their own unit —
sessions, ml, units or threads.
A course is planned in that unit, and what is
left is worked out from what was delivered.
Only the person who started a session
completes it.
The record names who did the work.
Completing early is shown to the doctor
with your note.
The doctor signed off a set number of
minutes.
A photo of the wrong person is flagged,
never deleted.
Nothing in a patient's record is silently
removed; a flagged photo disappears from
every screen but is kept.
A session that ran is never marked "Not
done today".
"Not done" means nothing was used up, so it
can only be used before the treatment
starts.
You do not set the next appointment. The support doctor sets it, because that is
the doctor the patient goes through before
she leaves.
There is nothing commercial on your
screen, on purpose.
The therapist's job is clinical only.
Gleuhr Guide — Therapist (draft)
Page 3 of 36

blocks.title: Page 4
blocks.text:
3 · Processes
My pages
The menu is on the left on a computer and at the bottom on a phone. Four pages, in this
order.
My patients — your home page. At the top are any running session (a big countdown and
Open session), any treatment whose time is up, and Save late for sessions from an earlier
day you never saved. Below that is Up next: numbing you were picked to apply, then your
own treatments in order, each with ONE button (Start, Numb or Close). Done today and
Not done today are folded at the bottom. Tap any patient to open the details.
Timers — every timer running for you: Picked for you to numb, In treatment, Numbing,
and Applied by you (numbing you put on for someone else's patient). The red number on
the menu is the same count. The + Apply numbing to a patient button is at the bottom.
Clinic floor — the clinic's rooms: yours ("You", with your patient), rooms in use by others
("in use"), and "free" rooms. Use it to find a free room before you start.
My day — your day in one list: tiles for done, now, to do and numbing, then everything you
started, a red Now line, and what is still to come.
Always in the top bar: the coral Apply numbing button, the Break chip, the search box
("Search your patients…"), and ? for How to use (this guide). Your initials (on a phone) or
your name (on a computer) opens Sign out.
How do I…? · My list and the sign-off
1. How do I see who I have to treat next?
When you need this: at the start of the day and after every session.
Steps:
1 . Open My patients.
2. Read Up next. Lines are in order of planned start. The time on a line is empty until
reception gives it a time.
3. Each line has one button: Start (ready now), Numb (numbing not started yet) or
nothing (still waiting).
What you'll see / if it goes wrong:
"Waiting session sign-off" — the doctor has not signed it off yet. Nothing to do; wait.
"No patient is waiting for you." — you have nothing assigned right now.
Gleuhr Guide — Therapist (draft)

2. How do I know the doctor has signed off?
When you need this: before you numb or start anyone.
Steps:
1 . On My patients, a line that still says "Waiting session sign-off" is not signed off.
2. Tap the line. In the details, "Signed off" shows the time and the doctor's name, or
"waiting for the doctor".
3. Once signed off, the line shows Start or Numb.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong: the details footer says "You can start once the doctor
signs off". If you try to start anyway, the app says "This session isn't signed off yet — the
doctor has to approve today's procedure and serums before it can start."
Who to ask: the doctor. If the patient is ready and still waiting, tell the doctor.
Search words: sign off, signed off, doctor approval, doctor ne approve, waiting for doctor,
locked, start nahi ho raha
[Screenshot to add: My patients, a line reading "Waiting session sign-off"]

How do I…? · Numbing
3. How do I apply numbing to my patient?
When you need this: a signed-off treatment needs numbing cream before it starts.
Steps:
1 . On My patients, press Numb on the line (or press the coral Apply numbing in the top
bar).
2. Patient — check the right patient is chosen. If not, choose from the list.
3. Ready in — it starts at this treatment's usual time. Use − and + to change it in steps of
5 minutes.
4. Applied by shows your own name. You cannot put someone else's name here.
5. Press Start numbing timer →.
6. Apply the cream in the waiting area. The timer is now on Timers.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong:
"The doctor hasn't signed off this session yet." — wait for the sign-off.
"This patient isn't checked in for today." — reception must check her in first.
"Numbing is already running for this session — cancel it first if the cream needs re-
applying."
"This session has already started, so numbing can no longer be applied to it."
"Only the therapist can apply numbing."
Who to ask: the doctor for the sign-off; reception for check-in.
Search words: numbing, numb, cream lagana, numbing cream, anaesthetic, EMLA,
numbing timer, numbing start, cream
Screenshot:
Gleuhr Guide — Therapist (draft)

blocks.title: Page 9

4. How do I numb a patient someone picked me for?
When you need this: the doctor or reception picked you to numb another therapist's
patient.
Steps:
1 . On My patients, the top of Up next shows "Apply numbing — <patient> (<name>'s
session)". On Timers it is under Picked for you to numb.
2. Press Apply numbing (or Apply numbing → on Timers).
3. Check Ready in and press Start numbing timer →.
4. Once applied, it moves to Applied by you on Timers. It runs on the session therapist's
timers, not yours.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong: the line stays on Up next "until you apply it". If it
disappears before you apply it, someone else applied it or the pick was cleared.
Who to ask: reception (they pick on Assign therapist) or the doctor.
Search words: picked to numb, numb for someone, dusre ka patient, numbing pick, Asha
to numb, apply for other therapist
[Screenshot to add: My patients, Up next with an "Apply numbing — … ('s session)" line on
top]
Gleuhr Guide — Therapist (draft)
Page 9 of 36

blocks.title: Page 10
blocks.text:
5. Why can't I start — the line says "<name> to numb"?
When you need this: another therapist was picked to numb your patient and has not
applied it yet.
Steps:
1 . The line reads "<first name> to numb" and Start is greyed.
2. Hold on the greyed button to read why: "<name> is picked to apply the numbing first
— Start opens once it is applied."
3. Wait for that therapist to apply it, or ask her.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong: once she applies it, the line shows the numbing time
and Start opens when ready. Only the Start button on My patients is held. The details
panel still shows Start treatment → and Start early, and the Numb button stays on — so
wait for the picked therapist to apply the numbing before you start, wherever you start
from.
Who to ask: the therapist named, or reception.
Search words: to numb, start greyed, start band, Asha to numb, can't start, numbing
pending, wait numbing
[Screenshot to add: My patients line "Asha to numb" with Start greyed]
6. How do I see how long until the skin is ready?
When you need this: while numbing is on.
Steps:
1 . Open Timers. Under Numbing, each line shows the minutes left, or "Ready".
2. The line turns green in its last 10 minutes.
3. Your phone also rings when numbing is ready — tap to stop it.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong: a numbing you put on for someone else's patient is
under Applied by you, not under Numbing.
Who to ask: —
Search words: numbing time, kitna time, timer, ready kab, numbing ready, minutes left,
countdown
Screenshot:

7. How do I cancel numbing?
When you need this: the cream was put on the wrong patient, or must be taken off.
Steps:
1 . On Timers, numbing you applied for someone else has Cancel numbing on its line
under Applied by you.
2. For numbing on your own patient: tap the line to open its details, then press Cancel
numbing.
3. It cancels at once — no question is asked. The record is kept.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong:
"Only whoever applied this numbing, or the patient's therapist, can cancel it."
"This numbing entry is already cancelled."
Who to ask: the therapist who applied it.
Search words: cancel numbing, numbing hatao, wrong cream, remove numbing, galat
patient numbing, undo numbing
[Screenshot to add: details panel with Cancel numbing and Start early]
8. How do I start early, before the numbing timer ends?
When you need this: the skin is ready sooner, or the patient cannot wait.
Gleuhr Guide — Therapist (draft)

2. Press Start early. It opens the session page at the Start step.
3. Carry on as in "How do I start a treatment?".

Who to ask: the doctor, if you are not sure the skin is ready.

How do I…? · Starting a treatment
9. How do I ﬁnd a free room?
When you need this: before you start a treatment.
Steps:
1 . Open Clinic floor. The strip shows how many rooms are "your sitting", "in use" and
"free".
2. A free room reads "free". Another person's room shows "in use" and "since" a time, with
no names.
3. On the session page, the Room menu also labels each room "free", "in use since …" or
"in use · your sitting".
What you'll see / if it goes wrong: "No rooms are set up for this clinic." — tell the branch
manager.
Who to ask: the branch manager, if rooms are missing.
Search words: room, free room, khali room, kaunsa room, room available, room in use,
clinic floor

10. How do I start a treatment?
When you need this: the line shows Start (or the details show Start treatment →).
Steps:
1 . Press Start on My patients. The session page opens at the Start step.
2. Read <name>'s sessions today — every session the doctor signed off for her today,
and who does each.
3. Room — choose a room ("Select room…").
4. Before photos — see who took them. Take one if needed (Take photo or From gallery).
5. Pre-treatment checklist — tick every line.
6. Machine settings photo — take it with the camera when it says REQUIRED.
7. Press Start treatment. The room shows "in use" for the whole clinic.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong:
Start treatment stays off until a room is chosen, every checklist line is ticked and a
REQUIRED photo is taken.
"Not on the doctor's sign-off yet — the doctor adds this session before it can be
started."
"This patient isn't checked in for today — reception has to check them in first."
"that room is in use — another sitting holds it until it is recorded or closed; choose
another room" — choose another room.
Gleuhr Guide — Therapist (draft)

"The doctor performs this session herself — it isn't yours to start or record."
"This session is already running — go back to the sessions list and open it; it picks up
where it left off."
"You're not allowed to start this session at this clinic." — it may not be assigned to you.
Ask reception.
Who to ask: the doctor for the sign-off; reception for check-in or assignment.

2. Tap the camera tile on the "Machine settings photo" line. The live camera opens —
never the gallery.

How do I…? · Recording and completing
13. How do I record the units, ml or threads I used?
When you need this: the treatment is measured in ml (filler), units (toxin) or threads
(thread lift).
Steps:
1 . On the Record step, find Units used. It is already filled in with the planned quantity.
2. If you used a different quantity, type what you really used.
3. Add a note saying why, in Add session notes · optional.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong: a quantity different from the plan is saved as a
deviation, and the doctor sees both. A plain sitting (facial, peel, laser) has no Units used
box — it counts as one session.
Who to ask: the doctor, before you change a dose.
Search words: units, ml, threads, kitna use hua, dose, quantity, botox units, filler ml,
deviation
[Screenshot to add: Record step with Units used and the read-only plan card]

14. How do I write a note for the doctor?
When you need this: anything happened that the doctor should know — a reaction, a
change, the patient's comment.
Steps:
1 . On the Record step, open Add session notes · optional.
2. Type what happened ("How did it go? Anything different from the plan? Write it
here.").
3. Carry on to Treatment done →.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong: the serum, the minutes and the area on the plan card
are the doctor's and cannot be changed here. If what you did differs, say so in the note.
Who to ask: —
Search words: note, session note, doctor ko batana, reaction, likhna, remark, comment
[Screenshot to add: Record step, notes box open]
15. How do I complete a session?
When you need this: the treatment is finished.
Steps:
1 . On the Record step, press Treatment done →.
2. Tick every line of the post-treatment checklist ("To complete this treatment, complete
the checklist below.").
3. Take the After photos (Take photo or From gallery).
4. Read what comes next for her (see "Apply numbing now" below).
5. Press Complete session. The session is logged and closed in one press.
6. "Session complete" shows the time, serum, photos and your note. Press Back to home.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong:
Complete session stays off until every post item is ticked and, for a unit treatment,
Units used is more than zero.
"This session is already logged — it can't be recorded twice. Go back to the sessions
list; it now shows as logged."
"You're not allowed to log this session at this clinic." — only the person who started it
completes it.
Who to ask: the doctor, if the app refuses for a reason you don't understand.
Search words: complete session, session khatam, done, finish treatment, save session,
close session, after photo
Gleuhr Guide — Therapist (draft)

16. How do I complete before the doctor's time is up?
When you need this: the treatment is really done but the countdown still shows time left.
Steps:
1 . Press Complete session.
2. "Complete before the time is up?" opens. It says how many minutes the doctor signed
off and how much is left.
3. Press Keep going to go back, or Complete early if the treatment is really done.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong: "Ending early is shown to the doctor with your note."
Write why in your note.
Who to ask: the doctor.
Search words: complete early, jaldi khatam, time left, early finish, end early
[Screenshot to add: the "Complete before the time is up?" sheet]
17. How do I end a timed treatment when my phone rings "time up"?
When you need this: a timed treatment reached zero.
Steps:
1 . Tap the alarm screen to stop it.
2. On My patients, the card reads "<Treatment> done · go to <Room>".
3. Press End treatment. It stops both alarms and opens the session at the Complete step.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong: the card keeps ringing "until you press End treatment".
If it is not ended by a set time, it goes to Unanswered alarms for the doctor, the branch
manager and the Sales Head.
Who to ask: —
Search words: time up, timer khatam, alarm baj raha, end treatment, go to room, timed
treatment
[Screenshot to add: My patients, the time-up card with End treatment]

When you need this: the patient has another treatment today that needs numbing.
Steps:
1 . On the Complete step, read "After this session, <name>'s next sessions are:".
Gleuhr Guide — Therapist (draft)

2. If the next one needs numbing, press Apply numbing now.
3. It shows " ✓  Numbing started … · ready …".
What you'll see / if it goes wrong: the button is off if the next session has no numbing
time set. "Last session of her visit. Nothing else is planned for <name> today." — nothing
more to do for her.

How do I…? · Mistakes and changes
19. How do I undo a start I pressed by mistake?
When you need this: you pressed Start treatment on the wrong patient or too soon.
Steps:
1 . On the Record step, press Undo start. It is there only for a short time after you started,
and only for your own start.
2. After that time it becomes Cancel start: write why ("Why required") and press Cancel
the start. Press Stay in the session to go back.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong:
"Say why you're going back, in a few words — it is recorded against the start."
"This session was recorded — its start can't be cancelled."
"Only the therapist who started this session, or the doctor with a reason, can cancel it."
Who to ask: the doctor, if the start was someone else's.
Search words: undo start, cancel start, galti se start, wrong patient start, go back, start
cancel
[Screenshot to add: Cancel start dialog "Go back — cancel the start?"]
20. How do I mark a treatment "Not done today"?
When you need this: a signed-off treatment will not happen today (the patient refused,
left, or cannot have it).
Steps:
1 . Tap the line to open its details.
2. Press Not done today.
3. Pick the reason. For "Other", write it.
Gleuhr Guide — Therapist (draft)
Page 19 of 36

blocks.title: Page 20
blocks.text:
4. Press Mark not done.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong:
"The session stays in the package for next time. Nothing is used up."
"… is already logged today — nothing to mark"
"… session started by … at …. She saves the log first; a session that ran is never
marked not done."
"The not-done reasons are not set up — ask the admin" — tell the branch manager.
Who to ask: the doctor, if you are unsure the treatment should be skipped.
Search words: not done, nahi hua, patient chali gayi, refused, skip treatment, cancel
treatment, aaj nahi
[Screenshot to add: Not done today dialog]
21. How do I save a session from an earlier day?
When you need this: Save late appears on My patients.
Steps:
1 . Under Save late, each line reads "from <date>, not saved".
2. Press Save and complete the session as usual.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong: it is recorded as saved late, under its own visit day, and
the visit can then be closed. "This visit is from an earlier day. Only a session you started on
it, and have not saved, can still be saved — nothing new can be started on it."
Who to ask: the branch manager.
Search words: save late, kal ka session, old session, not saved, earlier day, pending save
[Screenshot to add: My patients, Save late group]
How do I…? · History and photos
22. How do I open a patient's history?
When you need this: you want to see earlier sessions, reactions or photos.
Steps:
1 . Tap a line and press History in the details. On the session page, press Patient details.
2. Tabs: Overview (active treatments, skin, allergies, medicines), Sessions (each past
session, "deviation" or "as signed"), Photos.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong: the skin and medical details are doctor-recorded and
read-only for you.
Gleuhr Guide — Therapist (draft)

23. How do I ﬂag a photo of the wrong patient?
When you need this: a photo on this patient shows someone else.
Steps:
1 . Under the photo, press Wrong patient.
2. Read the warning: it "disappears from every screen (it is kept in the database, never
deleted) and is never used as this patient's photo; it cannot be undone."
3. Confirm.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong: "Couldn't flag the photo — …" — try again, or tell the
branch manager.
Who to ask: the branch manager.
Search words: wrong patient, galat photo, wrong photo, dusre ki photo, delete photo,
photo hatao

24. How do I ask for a break?

My patient is sitting in the waiting area but is not on my list. She may not be checked in,

I used a different quantity than the plan. Type the real quantity in Units used and write

I started the wrong patient. Use Undo start right away, or Cancel start with a reason.

I can't find a treatment's numbing time — "Ready in" shows "—". The treatment has no

What each rating means (approved by the founder, 27 Oct):
5: you did it alone, right first time, at normal desk speed.
4: you did it alone and right, but slower, or you caught and fixed your own small slip.
3: you needed one prompt, or made one mistake that had to be pointed out.
2: you needed several prompts, or made a mistake someone else had to fix.
1: you could not do it yet.
What the rater looks at in every task:
Steps: the right steps, in order, with nothing skipped.
Screen: the right page and buttons; refusals read and acted on.
Rules: this module's rules kept.
The people you deal with: clear and kind with the patient, and handed off to the right
colleague.
Pace: done at normal desk speed.
Ratings are not averaged. For example, 5, 5, 4, 3, 5 is "not yet": you repeat only the task
rated 3. No single mistake fails a task on its own; a mistake lowers that task's rating.
Every attempt and every rating is kept. You are In training until every lesson is passed
AND every task is rated 4 or 5. Then your BM signs you off as Trained. Nothing on your
desk is blocked while you are In training.
How it works: do the lessons in order. Read each lesson and its cards, then answer its 3
questions. If you fail, re-read the cards and try again.
Lesson 1 — What a therapist does — and doesn't
The doctor decides the treatment; you carry it out and record it. Reception checks
patients in and assigns them to you. The support doctor sets the next appointment.
Nothing commercial is on your screen. Read: cards 1, 31.

Why: clinical decisions are the doctor's; you carry out the sign-off.
Q2. Who sets the patient's next appointment?
a) You, at the end of the session · b) Reception · c) The support doctor ✓

Ready for sign-off: what your BM will ask you to show
On the real desk, with a real patient, while your BM watches. Each task is rated 1 to 5, and
each needs a 4 or 5.
1 . Find your next patient on My patients and tell whether she is signed off.
What a 5 looks like: opens My patients first, reads the line's state correctly (waiting for
sign-off, Numb, Start), and says who she would ask if a patient is missing.

started, and says when the skin will be ready.
3. Start a treatment: pick a free room, tick the pre-treatment checklist, take the
machine settings photo when required.

really checking it, and takes the machine settings photo with the live camera before
Start treatment.

Complete session.

checklist and completes the session.
